description: You are a database administrator at a digital music store using the Chinook database in LibreOffice Base. Management needs a revenue analysis system. Your task: (1) Create a saved SQL query named 'GenreRevenue' that computes total revenue per music genre — it must join InvoiceLine, Track, and Genre tables and group results by genre with a revenue aggregate; (2) Create a saved SQL query named 'CountryRevenue' that computes total sales revenue per billing country — it must join Invoice and Customer tables and group by billing country; (3) Create a new table named 'RevenueTarget' with at least these columns: TargetId (integer, primary key), Genre (text), AnnualTarget (numeric), Quarter (integer); (4) Insert at least 4 rows into RevenueTarget using realistic genre names (Rock, Jazz, Classical, Pop, etc.) and realistic annual revenue targets; (5) Create a report named 'Revenue Analysis' (the name must contain 'Revenue') that presents the genre revenue data. All objects must be saved in the chinook.odb file.
